problem.title: Parse Cart Event Timestamps for Trend Report
problem.prompt: The `cart_events` table logs raw timestamps when users add items to their cart, but the analytics team needs a clean report showing the year, the month name, the day of the month, and the hour of day (24-hour format) for each event. The `event_timestamp` column is stored as a TIMESTAMP and sometimes contains NULL values for failed logging attempts. Your task is to extract the year as an integer, the full month name (e.g., 'January'), the day of the month as an integer, and the hour as an integer. For any NULL timestamp, display 'N/A' for the year, month, and day columns, and -1 for the hour. Return columns named `event_id`, `event_year`, `event_month`, `event_day`, `event_hour`, ordered by `event_id` ascending. Use EXTRACT to get numeric parts, DATE_TRUNC to verify the month boundary, and TO_CHAR to format the month name.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE cart_events (event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_sku VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, event_timestamp TIMESTAMP);

composite_moves: COALESCE NULL timestamps to placeholder values

hints: You need to handle NULL timestamps by providing fallback values for each output column.
Use EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ...), EXTRACT(DAY FROM ...), and EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ...) to pull numeric parts from the timestamp.

Use TO_CHAR(event_timestamp, 'Month') for the full month name, and wrap each extracted value with COALESCE or CASE to replace NULLs with 'N/A' or -1 as appropriate. Remember TO_CHAR returns text, so cast the EXTRACT results to text for the N/A replacement.
problem.answer_key: SELECT event_id, COALESCE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_timestamp)::TEXT, 'N/A') AS event_year, COALESCE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(event_timestamp, 'Month')), 'N/A') AS event_month, COALESCE(EXTRACT(DAY FROM event_timestamp)::TEXT, 'N/A') AS event_day, COALESCE(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM event_timestamp)::INTEGER, -1) AS event_hour FROM cart_events ORDER BY event_id;

_meta.scenario: a fashion ecommerce site tracking add-to-cart and conversion

user_solution:
/*
The `cart_events` table logs raw timestamps when users add items to their cart, but the analytics team needs a clean report showing the year, the month name, the day of the month, and the hour of day (24-hour format) for each event.

The `event_timestamp` column is stored as a TIMESTAMP and sometimes contains NULL values for failed logging attempts.
Your task is to extract the year as an integer, the full month name (e.g., 'January'), the day of the month as an integer, and the hour as an integer.
For any NULL timestamp, display 'N/A' for the year, month, and day columns, and -1 for the hour.
Return columns named `event_id`, `event_year`, `event_month`, `event_day`, `event_hour`, ordered by `event_id` ascending.
Use EXTRACT to get numeric parts, DATE_TRUNC to verify the month boundary, and TO_CHAR to format the month name.
*/


SELECT
    event_id,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(year FROM event_timestamp)::VARCHAR, 'N/A') as event_year,
    COALESCE(TO_CHAR(event_timestamp, 'FMMonth'), 'N/A') as event_month,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(day FROM event_timestamp)::VARCHAR, 'N/A') as event_day,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(hour FROM event_timestamp)::int, -1) as event_hour
FROM cart_events
ORDER BY 1;
